smallResultWarnBelow.governs: the valid-measurement count below which a measurement panel shows the small-result warning

chartFloorBelow.governs: the valid-measurement count below which a measurement panel's distribution chart is suppressed

lowSlipCaveatBelowMetres.governs: the slip, in metres, below which an active window that includes it carries the low-slip caveat

displayPrecision.scarp_height.governs: the display precision of scarp height, in metres
displayPrecision.scarp_height.quote: scarp height and fault slip 0.01 m

displayPrecision.slip.governs: the display precision of fault slip, in metres
displayPrecision.slip.quote: scarp height and fault slip 0.01 m

displayPrecision.dzw.governs: the display precision of deformation-zone width, in metres

displayPrecision.scarp_dip.governs: the display precision of scarp dip, in degrees

logScaleMinDecades.governs: the number of decades the matched deformation-zone-width range must exceed for the panel to offer the logarithmic-scale toggle
